hero.title: Describe Your Site. It Builds Itself.
hero.description: Tell HABOS what you need. AI generates a complete multi-page React site with your brand, products, bookings, and forms — deployed to a live URL instantly.

body: Enter a competitor or reference website URL. Browser automation captures full-page screenshots, extracts DOM content, parses CSS design tokens, and detects logos and images. Before the AI builds, HABOS injects ten layers of workspace context: brand tokens, product catalog, booking widgets, shop components, form embeds, campaign surfaces, and an asset manifest. Products added in HABOS appear on the website automatically. Bookings flow into your calendar. Form submissions route to tickets or CRM leads.

caption.prompt: Build a plumbing company website with our services and a booking widget.
caption.suffix: Brand colors, products, and availability pulled from your workspace automatically.

benefits.title: Clone & improve

benefits.title: 10 enrichment layers
benefits.body: Brand tokens, product catalog, booking widgets, shop components, form embeds, campaign surfaces, asset manifest — all injected before the AI builds.

benefits.title: One-click rollback
benefits.body: Create unlimited versions. Preview before publishing. Roll back to any previous version instantly. Your live site is never at risk.

widgetsLabel: Live widgets that connect to your backend

scenario.heading: How it works in practice
scenario.body: A new client signs up and enters their current website URL. HABOS scrapes the site — captures design, content, images, and brand tokens. In under 2 minutes, a rebuilt version appears with HABOS commerce, booking, and forms wired in. Products added in the dashboard appear on the website automatically. Bookings flow into the calendar. Form submissions create tickets. One data layer, everywhere.

cta.heading: Other website builders are drag-and-drop. HABOS builds it for you.
